subsystems.name: dome
subsystems.note: onion: round bricks, 6x6 dish, 4x4 hemi, cone finial

content.text: Plan reviewed — shrinking the drum to 6×6 to clear the kiosks. Starting with the terrace.
Central hall walls with four tall iwan openings.
Levelling the arch course, two more courses, and interior columns for the dome.
Roof deck, then the drum and onion dome.
Rebuilding the dome fatter: square drum, round cornice, bulbous cap.
Four corner kiosks (chhatris) on the roof.
Raising the central drum so the great dome dominates.
Projecting pishtaq frames around each iwan.
Grey parapet on the roof edge and tiled garden paths.
Grey capstone tiles along the plinth edge.
